source.title: Installation
source.description: Install with pip, `uv`, Pixi or conda and verify via `marimo tutorial intro`; try `--sandbox` notebooks without a project; what `marimo[recommended]` extras unlock.

source.title: Quickstart
source.description: Tour of core CLI commands (`edit`, `run`, `convert`, `export`, `tutorial`), disabling autorun via `auto_instantiate`, `marimo[recommended]` extras, Copilot setup, and VS Code/PyCharm extensions.

source.title: Key concepts
source.description: Reactive execution mental model: why cell order doesn't matter, mutations aren't tracked, and UI elements must be global; plus `marimo run` apps and scripts.

source.title: Best practices
source.description: Avoid name clashes with `_`-prefixed cell-local variables, why mutations across cells aren't tracked, gating expensive cells with `mo.stop`, and avoiding `on_change` handlers.

source.title: FAQ
source.description: marimo vs Jupyter, stopping expensive cells auto-running, `on_change` handlers not firing, escaping SQL `{}`, `dotenv`, remote SSH and `--headless` use.

source.title: Recipes
source.description: Snippets for dynamic UI element lists (why plain Python lists fail), forms, `mo.stop`, button triggers, `mo.ui.refresh` timers and caching.

source.title: Using your own editor
source.description: Edit notebooks in neovim or VS Code with `--watch` syncing to the browser; the `.py` and Markdown file formats, `@app.function` exports, `watcher_on_save` autorun, WASM hot-reload.

source.title: Lint Rules
source.description: Running `marimo check` and `--fix`/`--unsafe-fixes`; table of every MB/MR/MF/MW rule code, e.g. multiple definitions, cycles, WASM incompatibilities.

source.title: marimo pair: work on notebooks with coding agents
source.description: Let Claude Code, Codex and others work in your running notebooks, exploring data, explaining results and editing cells alongside you.

source.title: Skills
source.description: Task skills, separate from marimo pair, for converting Jupyter notebooks to marimo or building custom anywidget widgets.

source.title: Configuring LLM providers
source.description: Set `chat_model`, `edit_model` and `autocomplete_model` per provider (Anthropic, Bedrock, Ollama, Copilot…), API keys via env vars or `env:`, custom OpenAI-compatible providers, and fixing `/v1` 404s.

source.title: Interactive dataframes
source.description: Transform pandas/Polars dataframes without code via `mo.ui.dataframe`, select rows with `mo.ui.table`, opt out with `mo.plain`, use row viewer and column explorer panels, set `default_sql_output`.

source.title: Using SQL
source.description: `mo.sql` cells over dataframes, files and databases: output types, escaping `{{ }}`, injection-safe parameters, refresh triggers, connecting engines, and why schema autocomplete is missing.

source.title: Plotting
source.description: Select data on charts via `mo.ui.matplotlib`, `mo.ui.altair_chart` or `mo.ui.plotly` and filter it in Python; plus displaying matplotlib figures, pan/zoom, `vegafusion` for Altair transforms, and the chart builder.

source.title: Snippets Configuration
source.description: Add reusable custom code snippets via `custom_paths` in `marimo.toml`, write the snippet file format, and disable built-in defaults with `include_default_snippets`.

source.title: Theming
source.description: Apply custom CSS via `css_file` or `custom_css`, the stable CSS variables, styling individual cells, forcing dark mode, and why plots ignore dark mode (matplotlib, plotly, bokeh, Altair).

source.title: Custom HTML Head
source.description: Inject analytics, fonts, meta tags or external scripts via `html_head_file`; explains why it's ignored in edit mode (only `marimo run`).

source.title: marimo
source.description: Large CLI reference to search, not read whole: every flag for `edit`, `run`, `new`, `convert`, `export` (html, wasm, ipynb, pdf), `check`, `cache`, `pair` and `recover`, incl. sandboxing and token auth.

source.title: Guides
source.description: Table of contents for all marimo guides, one line and URL each, for finding the page on an uncurated topic; mentions launching `marimo tutorial`.
